title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security on Printing and Distributing the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Drunk Driving Motor Vehicles
keywords_en: traffic accident; criminal case of drunk driving a motor vehicle
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Driving a Motor Vehicle While Intoxicated

Fa Fa [2013] No. 15

The High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, and Public Security Departments (Bureaus) of All Provinces, Autonomous Regions, and Municipalities Directly Under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, the Military Procuratorate of the People's Liberation Army, and the Security Department of the General Political Department; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; and the People's Procuratorate and Public Security Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

Since the implementation of Amendment VIII to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, local authorities have strictly enforced the law and investigated a number of criminal cases of driving a motor vehicle while intoxicated, achieving good legal and social results. To ensure the correct and uniform implementation of the law, to lawfully punish the crime of driving a motor vehicle while intoxicated, and to maintain public safety and the safety of people's lives and property, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security, after in-depth investigation and research and extensive consultation, have formulated the Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Driving a Motor Vehicle While Intoxicated. These are hereby issued to you. Please organize earnest study and ensure effective implementation. If problems arise during implementation, please promptly report them level by level to the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the Ministry of Public Security.

December 18, 2013

Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Driving a Motor Vehicle While Intoxicated

To ensure the correct and uniform implementation of the law, to lawfully punish the crime of driving a motor vehicle while intoxicated, and to maintain public safety and the safety of people's lives and property, these Opinions are formulated in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law and the Criminal Procedure Law, and in light of the practice of investigation, prosecution, and trial.

1. Driving a motor vehicle on a road with a blood alcohol content of 80 mg per 100 ml or more constitutes driving a motor vehicle while intoxicated and shall, in accordance with paragraph 1 of Article 133-1 of the Criminal Law, be convicted and punished as the crime of dangerous driving.

The terms "road" and "motor vehicle" as used in the preceding paragraph shall be governed by the relevant provisions of the Law on Road Traffic Safety.

2. Where a person drives a motor vehicle while intoxicated and falls under any of the following circumstances, a heavier punishment shall be imposed in accordance with paragraph 1 of Article 133-1 of the Criminal Law:

(1) Causing a traffic accident and bearing full or primary responsibility for the accident, or fleeing after causing a traffic accident, without yet constituting any other crime;
(2) Having a blood alcohol content of 200 mg per 100 ml or more;
(3) Driving on an expressway or an urban expressway;
(4) Driving a commercial motor vehicle carrying passengers;
(5) Engaging in serious violations of the Law on Road Traffic Safety, such as severe overloading of passengers or cargo, or overspeeding; driving a motor vehicle without a valid driver's license; or using forged or altered motor vehicle license plates or certificates;
(6) Evading inspection by the public security organ according to law, or refusing or obstructing inspection by the public security organ according to law, without yet constituting any other crime;
(7) Having previously received administrative penalties or been subject to criminal prosecution for driving a motor vehicle after consuming alcohol;
(8) Other circumstances that may warrant a heavier punishment.

3. Where a person drives a motor vehicle while intoxicated and obstructs an inspection by the public security organ according to law by means of violence or threats, thereby also constituting the crime of obstructing public service or another crime, the person shall be punished in accordance with the provisions on concurrent punishment for multiple crimes.

4. When imposing a fine on a defendant convicted of driving a motor vehicle while intoxicated, the amount of the fine shall be determined based on the circumstances, such as the defendant's degree of intoxication, whether actual damage was caused, and the attitude toward admitting guilt and showing remorse, so as to be commensurate with the principal punishment.

5. When a public security organ investigates a suspect suspected of driving a motor vehicle while intoxicated, it shall make records of the process of apprehension, the breath alcohol content test, and the blood sample collection process; where conditions permit, photographs, audio recordings, or video recordings shall be taken; and if there are witnesses, their testimony shall be collected.

6. The forensic examination opinion on blood alcohol content is the basis for determining whether a suspect is intoxicated. If a suspect who has undergone a breath alcohol content test and whose result meets the intoxicated standard provided in Article 1 of these Opinions escapes before a blood sample is collected, the breath alcohol content test result may be used as the basis for determining that the person is intoxicated.

If a suspect, when being inspected by the public security organ according to law and for the purpose of evading legal liability, consumes alcohol again before the breath alcohol content test or blood sample collection, and upon testing, the blood alcohol content meets the intoxicated standard provided in Article 1 of these Opinions, the suspect shall be deemed to be intoxicated.

7. Criminal cases of driving a motor vehicle while intoxicated shall be handled in strict accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law, and the procedural rights of suspects and defendants shall be effectively protected. Investigation, prosecution, and trial shall be conducted promptly within the statutory time limits.

For suspects and defendants who drive a motor vehicle while intoxicated, detention or release on bail pending trial may be applied depending on the circumstances of the case. If the conditions for release on bail are met but the suspect or defendant is unable to provide a surety or pay a deposit, residential surveillance may be applied. If a suspect or defendant subject to release on bail or residential surveillance violates the relevant provisions and the circumstances are serious, arrest may be carried out.
